notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
- Fixed text bug of Traders, they now show the right mana income.
- Fixed '''Blackwhole'' to ''Blackhole'' 
- Quick fix of the bug where the player keep being sent back to the main menu when trying to start a new run.


Note: The bug might still be there, but we are still checking and will update if it is still there. But we do hope that it is gone now :)

Thanks for your supports.
